description: Read dated building-permit records for one exact property, including agency status, application/issue/completion dates, unit counts, project cost, zoning labels and observed changes. Connected sources are Seattle building permits, Everett permits and Pierce County PALS records; this is not complete city/county coverage. Other municipal sources return official lookup resources while commercial permission is unresolved. Use address or county plus parcelId. Match uses exact county/parcel or recorded street, unit and ZIP; no records does not prove no permits, and permit labels do not establish current development rights. Source update times may represent a bulk republish; distinguish source dates from observation time. The result includes an 'attributions' array (upstream source lines and the NWMLS/DOR/county non-affiliation line) and a professional-advice disclaimer — pass both through to end users.
name: wa_permit_history
title: Property permit history and observed changes
